items.severity: major (data loss: a commit the person made in a task's folder is dropped without a word)
items.title: A resume of a branch whose pull request is open (the Tasks-row Redo of a done task with no merge card, a Try again) resets the task's folder to GitHub's branch and drops a commit the person made there without a word (the W15-02 sibling)
items.evidence: Review of w15-merge, non_blocking[6]; fix-up report not_done[1] and new_problems[1] (the place and both options); merge problems_left[1] (4). Read at 3600089.
items.root_cause_at_head: Holds at 3600089: packages/capabilities/src/githost/pr-executor.ts:981 resume = (!!existingPr && !dropped) || !!wip; with no work in progress :1011 'else await git.createBranch(branch, `origin/${branch}`)' puts the local branch on GitHub's head with no folderHold check (folderHold :277-310 is used only by the rebuild path :2005-2031 and the merge's folder wait). Before it, :921 cleanAfterCutShortRun sets anything uncommitted aside under failedRef (kept, but silently), for a done task's folder too.
items.notes: Decision (session lead, the safe direction, consistent with W15-02's rebuild and ADR 0111 'a commit pushed afterwards is never merged by Forerunner'): hold, never reset and never bring the commit along unasked. Before the reset, folderHold(git, branch, base) === 'commits' (and uncommitted changes in a folder whose last run finished) stops the run before any model call: nothing reset, no spend, one sentence on the Tasks row and in the session log naming the folder and the two ways out ('"X" was not redone: its task folder has a commit that is not on GitHub. Push it or undo it, then press Redo.'), the session goes on with other tasks. Preferred where the daemon can tell at once: the Redo itself answers with that sentence and changes nothing. The open owner question on whether Tasks-row actions start work stays as built (no start). A new owner question asks the owner to confirm hold over bring-along.

Stop it first.', the undoBlocked pattern of the W15-36 fix-up), and the project's page says '<name> was removed.' with no Start session or Create a repository.

items.severity: minor (security: no hostile test of the chat's card facts)
items.title: No injection case covers the chat's facts: since W15-30 a card quotes up to 300 characters of the specialist's words (which can come from a web page) to the chat model, which holds command tools; the data rule added in the fix-up is tested only by its exact system text

items.root_cause_at_head: evals/injection/cases holds 19 email and 40 web cases, none for the conversation; packages/runtime/src/conversation/agent.ts CHAT_OPEN_REQUEST_RULES carries the rule and packages/runtime/test/conversation-memory.test.ts asserts its text only. Widening changes need a Yes; narrowing ones act at once (an injected 'only read x.example' narrows the site rule with no Yes).
items.notes: One hostile case through the person's boundary: a questions card whose quoted words tell the model to change a setting, cancel a task or widen the site rule; the chat turn makes no change without the person's Yes and narrows nothing on the card's say. If the injection harness cannot express a chat case in time, write the same assertion as a composed conversation test (the bench model-call log or the request builder) and log the harness gap. Run C's D3 (the chat recalls anything recorded) widens what reaches that model; this case is the base its own injection tests build on.

items.severity: minor (timers and GitHub calls after stop; a poll held for N x 15 s)
items.title: The null-mergeable re-read (W15-07) waits up to about 15 s per pull request, one after another, not per poll as decided, on a real setTimeout that stop() does not cancel: after Quit a poll can go on calling GitHub, and a main branch move with N open PRs holds one poll for N x 15 s
items.evidence: Review of w15-merge non_blocking[0]; fix-up not_done[2] (not changed); read at 3600089.
items.root_cause_at_head: packages/runtime/src/session/githost-watcher.ts:376 realDelay = new Promise(setTimeout) (not the watcher's clock); :563-571 the loop runs per PR inside readPullRequest; stop() (:412-415) cancels only the next tick.
items.notes: About 15 s of re-reads per poll in all, through the watcher's clock so stop() ends the wait; no GitHub call after stop. Validation rule: processes and timers are tested for what is left after stop and Quit.
